copy.title: Example Sim
copy.hero: A hypothetical Royco Senior/Junior market over the Example strategy. Senior is protected by Junior's first-loss buffer; Junior earns yield for taking that risk.
footerParagraphs: The underlying is a synthetic 24-point monthly fixture covering January 2024 through December 2025. It exists only to prove that a pasted date/price CSV can render through the locked simulator template.
This is a counterfactual mechanism illustration, not a track record or announced product.
Backtest math uses the shared Royco Day accountant engine and the repository parity suite. The fixture data and parameters are intentionally illustrative.
